body:
New kanban_boards table, board 1 = EINHORN_INDUSTRIAL, board_id added to kanban_cards (DEFAULT 1, zero data migration, zero behavior change for existing callers). list/create now board-aware (?board_id=/board_id in POST body, both default to board 1). Position-lookup for new cards now board-scoped. Real design: git-file sync stays board-1-only, other boards are genuinely self-contained. New TestKanban_BoardIDScopesListAndCreate. go build/vet/test ./... clean, zero regressions. Deliberately not built this phase: board management CRUD API, per-board auth (matches MULTI_KANBAN_NORTHSTAR.md's own Phase 2/3).

⚓ ☃
title: MULTIKANBAN-000 Phase 1: real kanban_boards table + board-aware card CRUD shipped
